Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a specialized Chemical Cross-Linking Mass Spectrometry (XL-MS) study. While it uses DDA and LFQ-like identification, it does not fit the standard PTM enrichment modifiers (like phospho or ubiquitin) provided in the ontology list. The search parameters include specific crosslinker mass shifts (SDA-loop) and standard variable modifications.

scope: All targets in the XL-assisted modelling category were solved by X-ray crystallography and provided to the XL-MS labs as purified protein samples.
